name: Laravel 12 + Filament 3 + MySQL
note: Each task runs a real command. No token figures are recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost directly from the kit files. The suite is Pest and runs against SQLite in-memory (DB_CONNECTION=sqlite, DB_DATABASE=:memory: in phpunit.xml) so no MySQL or Redis service is required. MySQL MATCH AGAINST cannot run on SQLite, so the full-text scope is asserted on its generated SQL and bindings, and the fulltext index migration is skipped on SQLite. MySQL strict modes are asserted against the shipped connection config. SEC-12 (deadlock retry), SEC-13 (Semgrep) and SEC-14 (Gitleaks) are not exercised by this suite.

eval_tasks.title: Application installs and boots
eval_tasks.instruction: Composer dependencies must resolve and the Laravel application must bootstrap far enough to list its routes.

eval_tasks.title: Feature behaviour
eval_tasks.instruction: The kit's feature tests must pass.
assertions: policy allows own team and admin only

eval_tasks.title: Declared security controls hold under test
eval_tasks.instruction: Run the suite that exercises the controls named in security/checks.json. Each test is mutation-verified: removing the control makes the test fail.
assertions: SEC-03 list and edit are team-scoped; create is forced into creators team; delete is admin only
SEC-04 MATCH AGAINST term is bound
SEC-06 role and team_id are not mass-assignable
SEC-07 panel keeps CSRF and cookie encryption middleware
SEC-10 Filament login throttles after 5 attempts

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete suite must pass with no failures.
